entries.title: Psalms 131:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 David, professing his humility, 3 exhorts Israel to trust in God.

(Title.) A Song of degrees.Some think that this Psalm was composed by David when accused by Saul and his courtiers that he affected the crown; though others refer it to the time of the captivity; and consider it as containing a fair account of the manner in which the captives behaved themselves.

122:1; 124:1; 133:1; *titles my heart. Nu 12:3; De 17:20; 1Sa 16:13,18,22; 17:15,28,29; 18:23; Mt 11:29 Ac 20:19; 1Th 2:6,7,10 neither. 78:70-72; Jer 17:16; 45:5; Am 7:14,15; Ro 12:16 exercise. Heb. walk. high for me. Heb. wonderful for me. 139:6; Job 42:3; Ro 11:33

entries.title: Psalms 131:3
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Let Israel. 115:9-11; 130:7; 146:5; Jer 17:7,8 from henceforth. Heb. from now. 115:18; Isa 26:4
